_comment: All optional. Copy to ~/.clauled.json only if you need one of these.
_port: Override device auto-detection. Windows COM8, Linux /dev/ttyACM0, macOS /dev/cu.usbmodem*
_debug: Capture raw statusline and hook payloads to ~/.clauled-debug.log
_token: OAuth token from 'claude setup-token'. Enables the 5h subscription gauge. Without it that gauge shows --
